cues: Unguided media send signals through free space.
Radio waves spread in all directions and pass through walls.
Microwaves need line of sight; Wi Fi uses them.
Infrared works only within a room.
Satellites cover the globe, but with a delay of about a quarter of a second each way.
Wireless is quick to install and mobile, but less secure: anyone in range can listen.
